title: InstancesJson
description: JSON Schema for a single screen's <ScreenName>.instances.json — the flat component-instances list consumed by component-census.mjs. figmaNodeId is the mandatory OWNING component-SET id used as registry identity; it is never the instance's own node id. nodeUrl deep-links the instance's own node so a MISSING component has a node to cite.

figmaNodeId.description: OWNING component-SET id; never the instance's own id

nodeUrl.description: deep link to the instance's OWN node — for citing a MISSING component in the task-prep Step-5.5 split
